Cross-owner setup and ontology commits are not claimed atomic. Explicit lock order, original intent/pre/post states, linked completion receipt, partial diagnostics and identical-request recovery prevent false setup completion.

Custom/incomplete packages, missing owner or publication authority, legacy role layouts, collisions and changed source/target versions remain preserved named holds. No matching bytes or registry membership confers overwrite authority.
Future native owner, service/browser, real product and external observations are unexercised. Their missing scope cannot be replaced with fixtures, configured flags or historical reports.
